messages.text: Compare Cedar and Birch using the following preserved sources. Cedar: 8 USD/month, export API supported. Birch: 5 USD/month, no export API. I need an export API and a monthly cost at most 10 USD.
Cedar satisfies both requirements: it costs 8 USD/month and supports an export API.
Keep the recommendation concise and explain why Birch does not qualify.
Choose Cedar: 8 USD/month with an export API. Birch is cheaper but lacks the required export API.

warnings: Synthetic example; prices and services are fictional.
